rationale: W0, one shot. Two cause-specific log-hazards over the role-aware conditions and elapsed time. Extinction: a radiative-loss index (flow, pressure, adiabatic temperature) and a hazard that rises while the flame grows, then stays flat. Operator termination: a protocol hazard with no dependence on conditions. Every number is a hypothesis written before the model was run; the time scales in particular are guesses that only data can settle. See edits.wsp.
